title: Vowel Spellchecker
description: Spellcheck queries against a dictionary, prioritizing exact matches, case-insensitive matches, and vowel-insensitive matches.
pseudocode:
1. exact = new Set(wordlist)
2. cap = new Map()
3. vow = new Map()
4. for word in wordlist:
5.   lower = word.toLowerCase()
6.   devowel = lower.replace(/[aeiou]/g, '*')
7.   if (!cap.has(lower)) cap.set(lower, word)
8.   if (!vow.has(devowel)) vow.set(devowel, word)
9. for q in queries:
10.  if exact.has(q) return q
11.  if cap.has(q.toLowerCase()) return cap.get(q.toLowerCase())
12.  if vow.has(q.toLowerCase().replace(/[aeiou]/g, '*')) return vow.get(devowel)
13. return ''
